events.title: Wood Street Documentary
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description:
Film Night: Wood Street (2026)
Date: Tuesday, October 27, 2026 - 7 PM
Location: Wooden Shoe - 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147

Two unhoused men turned community leaders organize their neighbors in the face of displacement, addiction, and a failing social system. Their story is a powerful testament to resilience, solidarity, and the right to remain.. It's about what unhoused people build for themselves, and the communities the cities destroy with encampment evictions.

At its peak, Wood Street in West Oakland was home to around 300 unhoused people. It was the largest encampment in Northern California. Residents built a community: homes, gardens, showers, a free store, and common spaces. When the city and state moved to evict them, they fought back. They confronted city officials, protested outside City Hall, and fought the government in court.

The Wood Street fight is relevant to homeless struggles in Philadelphia. Encampment sweeps are happening in many parts of Philadelphia, and in particular in South Philly. Over the last six years, advocates have been defending homeless encampments along the Delaware River, along main thoroughfares and in our parks. Join us to watch the film and talk about what solidarity with our unhoused neighbors looks like in South Philly.

This screening is a fundraiser for South Philly homeless advocacy's Winter campaign. Suggested donation $ 10, no one turned away for lack of funds.

Venmo: @sporesporespore
Masks are required. We'll have masks on hand. 
Run time: 100 minutes. Discussion to follow.

Thank you to all of the volunteers at the Wooden Shoe! Do not forget to purchase a book! 

Organized by SPORE (South Philly Outreach, Research and Education)

events.title: Fundraiser 4 Amal
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description: The Dirty Girlz collective is hosting a fundraising event for a postpartum mother in Gaza named Amal, located at the wooden shoe bookstore. Amal is a mother of four children whose lives have been forever changed by the genocide occurring in Palestine, and she needs our support. The event will include live music & poetry performances, as well as have crafting stations set up for people to collage and make bracelets.

events.title: A Celebration of Arguments: Poems - with Ben Gucciardi, Fatemeh Shams and Grady Chambers
events.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
events.description: Join Ben Gucciardi, Fatemeh Shams, and Grady Chambers for an evening of poetry at Wooden Shoe Books: three writers whose work engages questions of power, place, memory and the possibilities of making a life in a complicated world. Come hear distinctive voices in contemporary poetry and celebrate the launch of Arguments, Gucciardi's new collection, recently published by Persea Books.
